profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
11+ years of experience in Build & Release domain.
Vast experience in the DevOps role encompassing automation, continuous delivery,
continuous deployment and software configuration management.
Good exposure on AWS cloud technologies and infrastructure automation using Chef.
Have successfully played and executed various roles like Lead Release Engineer, Senior
Associate Infrastructure, Team Lead and Build & Release associate.
Good working experience using Agile Scrum development practices.

positions.title: Lead release engineer
positions.description:
Working at the client location, Target 
● Setup continuous integration using Jenkins for Search Product team.
● Configured Udeploy tool for deploying the build artifacts to local and production
environments.
● Prepared deployments instruction for deploying to Stage and Production environments,
and supported the Operations team during production deployments.
● Configured Sonarqube tool for code quality dashboard
● Setup the Perf Lab for Search Team using the Blazmeter tool and also configured the
Jenkins jobs to run the Blazemeter tests on daily basis
● Migrated all the build scripts from Maven to Gradle, I was also responsible for migrating all
the build Jobs to a Centralized Jenkins master.
● With the help of Cloud Platform Engineering Team, migrated the infrastructure to AWS
cloud.
● Created Chef recipes for automating the code deployment to AWS EC2 instances
● Created AWS CFNs, which were used for the creation of infrastructure for the Search
components.
● Houston, an in-house tool for deployment to cloud was used initially, and later used
Spinnaker for EC2 deployments
● Spinnaker Migration required to use RPMs instead of Chef recipes hence created the
RPMs for various Search components.
● Educated the team to deploy to Non production environments using Houston and
Spinnaker

positions.title: Release Engineer
positions.description:
•	Part of the 3 member Release engineering team for Yahoo Small Business
•	Identified gaps in the already existing CI setup and devised & implemented end to end Continuous Integration pipeline for Yahoo Web hosting Project
•	Designed  & setup the CI pipeline for YSB Platform & Domains project. CI jobs deployed to Test , Integration and Stage environments
•	Well versed with in-house tools like Igro (Configuration Management), Pogo (Deployments to remote boxes), Dist (Similar to Artifactory). Automated the build process to to use the above mentioned tools during the build and deployment
•	Maintained the CI Farm for the YSB projects and has helped in creating a QA CI farm where any changes / Jenkins plugins would be tested in advance before propagating the changes to the production Farm
•	Helped in SVN to Git migration, and also helped the team with the common SCM operations like creating branches, merging etc in both SVN and Git
•	Helped in migrating Jenkins jobs from YSB farm to  ‘The Factory’ & ‘Screwdriver’ farms as part of the ‘single Jenkins farm across the company’ initiative
•	As part of the continuos delivery initiative of the company, migrated Web hosting build system from the ‘Buildy block framework’ to the ‘Arya framework’ 
•	Designed and implemented a CD framework for Yahoo Commerce Central (YCC) team (formerly Lexity) which uses tools like artifactory as a package repository and Capistrano for deployment. This framework does not use Yahoo tool-stack such as yinst, igor, pogo etc. 
•	Did a spike in Chef and also attended Chef training in Yahoo

positions.title: Senior Associate Technology
positions.description:
Leading a Centralized Build and Release team who specializes in Continuous integration and Release automation of Java Projects
● Create / Maintain re-usable assets on build and release tools and technologies
● Standardizing the build and release process for various technology stacks, and
educating the team on the best approaches to be followed.
● Evaluation of LinkedIn Glu as a deployment automation platform
● Manages a shared pool of people for DAYCQ projects alone, who will be following a
standardized build and deployment framework created for DAY CMS.
● Responsible for requirement gathering and allocation of best fit candidates for the
same.
● Suggests best practices / solutions to projects after conducting a detailed study of their
Build and Release requirement.
● First level of escalation point for projects served from this centralized team.
● Design and maintain the complete Ramp up plan for the new joiners and mentoring the
new joiners in the team.
● Conduct / Arrange knowledge sharing sessions within the team.

educations.schoolName: Kristu Jayanti College Of Management And Tech
